about: The epistola of the formulary “Saint Andrew the Apostle” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: For with the heart one believes, and this leads to justice; but with the mouth confession is made, and this leads to salvation. For the Scripture says: No one believing in Him will be brought to shame. Indeed, there is no difference between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord of all is rich toward all who call on Him. For everyone who has called on the Lord’s name will be saved. So how will they call on Him in whom they have not believed? Or how will they believe Him they have not heard? How, moreover, will they hear with no one to preach? But how will they preach if they are not sent? As it is written: How lovely the feet of those who bring the good news of peace, who bring the good news of good things! Yet not everyone obeys the gospel. Isaiah indeed says: Lord, who believed our message? Faith, then, is from hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ. Still I say: Did they not hear? And indeed their sound has gone forth into all the earth, and their words to the ends of the world.
